test_sample_from_island_ratios: run the unittest suite to verify sample_from_island respects exploration exploitation and weighted sampling ratios
test_exploration_exploitation_random_rat: run test_exploration_exploitation_random_ratios to verify sampling mode distribution matches configured ratios within tolerance
test_sample_from_island_returns_from_cor: run test_sample_from_island_returns_from_correct_island to verify sampled parents and inspirations belong to the requested island
test_empty_island_fallback: run test_empty_island_fallback to verify sampling from an empty island falls back to the default sample method
test_single_program_island: run test_single_program_island to verify sampling from an island with only one program returns that program
